title: Addresses in filings.
bodyText: Whenever a provision of this chapter other than section 425R-10(a)(4) requires that a filing state an address, the filing shall state an actual street address or rural route box number in the State.
bodyHtml: [§425R-3]  Addresses in filings.  Whenever a provision of this chapter other than section 425R-10(a)(4) requires that a filing state an address, the filing shall state an actual street address or rural route box number in the State. [L 2009, c 55, pt of §1]
